answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 85 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a kernel bet on surviving 85 epochs of grading, and every mesa settlement recomputes the umber schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 14 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. That is 8 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
